title: Highway 2000
overview:
High Performance on the Highway!

Rev up for the road race of the century! Highway 2000 delivers driving excitement with all cylinders firing! Fly through five harrowing highway courses with your choice of three high performance racing machines - the speed and handling of the Mad Viper, the awesome acceleration of the Dark Nebula and the stick-to-the-road grip of the Rapid Fire. Slide with all four wheels into a hairpin curve. Negotiate treacherous tunnels, narrow bridges and heavy highway traffic. Challenge a fellow racer to a winner takes all, split screen barn burner! You can see the action from above, from the road or from the driver's seat. It's your race! Get out onto the highway and go!

- Realistic Racing Action!
- Five Highway Courses!
- Three Furious Racing Machines!
- Two Player Competition!
